name: the Length-info dropdown gate is narrowed back to "Length" only
why: isLengthCol is the single gate that lets release-tracks' bespoke "Recording length" column populate the same "Length info - Duration/Deviation/Milliseconds/Live status" sections "Length" gets. Narrowing it back silently drops all four sections for that one column, with no error anywhere — the dropdown just renders the plain value list again, exactly the reported bug.
grep: the same "Length info" sections populate for "Recording length" too
